description: This Dart source file defines the ApiClient class which provides static methods for making HTTP API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). It centralizes base URL resolution from environment variables and simplifies API interactions for the frontend web application.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing URLs and making HTTP requests, including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, with support for environment-based configuration and headers.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: A getter that retrieves the base URL for API requests from environment variable 'BACKEND_BASE_URL' or defaults to 'http://localhost:8000'. It trims trailing slashes for consistency.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object by joining the base URL with a given path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path, allowing optional headers, query parameters, and a Bearer token for authorization.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON-encoded body, supporting optional headers and Bearer token.

methods.name: putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON-encoded body, supporting optional headers and Bearer token.

methods.name: deleteJson
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path with optional headers and Bearer token.
